About the job
Our shared service center in Warsaw serves the German-speaking customers of a European insurance group. The customer service unit has 90 German-speaking agents and handles phone, e-mail and chat.

Responsibilities
• Lead the customer service unit and its four team leads on site in Warsaw
• Improve service levels and first contact resolution
• Align processes and KPIs with the German headquarters
• Coach team leads and build a quality monitoring routine

Requirements
• Several years of customer service leadership
• German and English fluent
• Willingness to work on site in Warsaw five days a week

Terms
• 6 months, start December 2026
• €900 per day plus travel
